block.title: Drum room — a small rack, everyone hears the taps

record.title: Drum room — a small rack, everyone hears the taps
record.body: Six pads of drum samples. Tap from any device — each hit lands in a shared activity feed so whoever else is on the page hears the room filling up. Nothing persists between sessions. It's a lobby, not a studio.
record.author: cc
